difficulty_why: Creating a public OAuth app requires a dedicated developer account and accepting the Acceptable Use Policy. Any customer can connect immediately up to a 25-account install cap, but scaling beyond 25 installs requires App Marketplace review.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Registering a free developer account, configuring OAuth settings with Composio redirect URI and scopes, and retrieving client credentials for initial testing.

launch_time.label: Same day (up to 25 accounts)
launch_time.text: Unlisted marketplace OAuth apps can be installed on up to 25 customer accounts immediately after signing the Acceptable Use Policy; expanding beyond 25 accounts requires App Marketplace listing review, which takes up to 10 business days.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom branding on OAuth consent
own_app_reasons.text: Display your own company name, logo, and integration details on the HubSpot OAuth consent screen instead of Composio's default application branding.

own_app_reasons.label: Scope customization
own_app_reasons.text: Request only the specific CRM and data scopes necessary for your product's workflow, avoiding deprecated scopes and minimizing user permission requirements during install.

app_type.label: Public OAuth App (Marketplace Distribution)
app_type.text: Create a public app with OAuth authentication and marketplace distribution. Static token apps only install in a single account, and private OAuth apps are restricted to 10 allowlisted accounts, whereas marketplace OAuth apps allow external customers to authorize and connect their accounts (up to 25 accounts prior to listing, and unlimited accounts after marketplace listing).

prerequisites.label: HubSpot developer account
prerequisites.text: A free HubSpot developer account is required; registration is self-serve with no credit card required.

prerequisites.label: Developer test accounts
prerequisites.text: You can create up to 10 free developer test accounts with 90-day trial access to enterprise features under Development > Testing > Test Accounts.

prerequisites.label: Super Admin permissions
prerequisites.text: Users must possess Super Admin permissions in their developer account to create and manage OAuth apps.

prerequisites.label: Verified domain
prerequisites.text: Domain verification requires adding a TXT record to your DNS settings; propagation can take up to 48 hours and helps prevent unverified app warnings.

prerequisites.label: HubSpot CLI
prerequisites.text: Install HubSpot CLI (@hubspot/cli version 7.6.0+) and authenticate via personal access key to build and deploy developer projects.

steps.label: Create HubSpot developer account
steps.text: Visit the HubSpot developer portal and click 'Create developer account' to register a free account.

steps.label: Initialize app project
steps.text: Run `hs project create` in your terminal, select App as the base content, and configure marketplace distribution and OAuth authentication.

steps.label: Configure redirect URI and scopes
steps.text: In your project directory, edit `src/app/app-hsmeta.json` to add the Composio redirect URI and default scopes under the auth configuration.

steps.label: Upload project to HubSpot
steps.text: Run `hs project upload` from the project directory in your terminal to deploy your OAuth app to your developer account.

steps.label: Open app settings in console
steps.text: Log in to your HubSpot developer account, navigate to Development > Projects, and select your uploaded app project.

steps.label: Retrieve Client ID and Client Secret
steps.text: Under Project Components, select your app, navigate to the Auth tab, and copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the Client credentials section.

steps.label: Sign Acceptable Use Policy
steps.text: Click the Distribution tab, select Begin publishing, and sign the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) to enable external account installations.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: Review is not required to create or install an OAuth app on up to 25 customer accounts; review approval is only required to list on the HubSpot App Marketplace and lift the 25-install cap.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: The Ecosystem Quality team checks OAuth implementation, active install count (minimum 3 unique accounts), scope necessity and shared data mapping, public setup documentation, live URLs, pricing consistency, and trademark compliance.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Initial listing review takes up to 10 business days, and the entire review and feedback resolution cycle must finish within 60 days.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: HubSpot charges no fees for listing or certifying apps in the HubSpot App Marketplace, and there is no revenue sharing.

approval.label: Common rejections
approval.text: Listing submissions are rejected or set to draft for requesting unused scopes, missing bi-directional data flow documentation, crawler-blocked setup URLs, pricing discrepancies, or trademark misuse.

approval.label: Before approval
approval.text: Before review approval, unlisted apps can be installed on up to 25 accounts, display an unverified app banner on OAuth consent, and are rate limited to 110 requests per 10 seconds per portal.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: Marketplace distribution apps created on or migrated to the developer platform are capped at 25 installs until approved for a Marketplace listing; private distribution apps are capped at 10 customer portals (or 100 for Solutions Partners).

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: Public OAuth apps have an API rate limit of 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account (API limit add-ons do not apply), and unlisted public apps trigger an unverified warning banner on the OAuth installation screen.

pitfalls.label: Pre-listing install limit
pitfalls.text: Marketplace distribution OAuth apps are hard-capped at 25 account installations until the app is submitted to and approved by HubSpot for an App Marketplace listing.

pitfalls.label: Acceptable Use Policy signing
pitfalls.text: You must click Begin publishing on the Distribution tab and sign the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP); until signed, the app cannot be installed on accounts other than developer test accounts.

pitfalls.label: Minimum 3 active installs required to submit
pitfalls.text: Apps cannot be submitted for marketplace review to lift the 25-install cap until they have at least 3 active, unique unaffiliated HubSpot production accounts with API activity in the past 30 days.

pitfalls.label: Unverified domain warning banner
pitfalls.text: Unless a verified domain is configured via DNS TXT record or the app is certified/listed, users see an unverified app security banner requiring manual confirmation (typing 'I accept the risk') to install.

pitfalls.label: Deprecated scopes in default set
pitfalls.text: Scopes 'accounting' and 'e-commerce' are officially deprecated by HubSpot and should be omitted from new app configurations to avoid configuration errors.

pitfalls.label: Plan-restricted scope failures
pitfalls.text: Requesting scopes for features unavailable in the target account tier (such as Enterprise-only custom objects or CMS scopes in CRM-only accounts) as required scopes will cause installation to fail; configure tier-specific permissions as optional scopes instead.

email_subject: Inquiry regarding HubSpot OAuth public app install limits and review process for [Application Name]
email_body:
Hi HubSpot Developer Support Team,

I am building an integration for our application ([Application Name]) that connects user accounts via OAuth 2.0 to sync CRM data, deals, contacts, and related entities using Composio.

We have registered a public app with marketplace distribution and configured our redirect URI:
Redirect URI: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add

Could you please confirm:
1. Our app is currently in development and unlisted. We understand unlisted apps are subject to a 25-account install limit and an unverified app banner. Are there any restrictions on customer installations within this 25-account threshold once the Acceptable Use Policy is signed?
2. When we prepare to submit for App Marketplace listing to lift the 25-account cap, what are the current review lead times for integrations requesting CRM and sales email scopes?
3. Are there specific requirements for OAuth apps connecting via an integration middleware backend like Composio regarding domain verification and callback validation?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title / Company]
[Your Contact Information]
